description: One stock market sector's drill-down: the top 3 member stocks ranked by opportunity, the member count and a count of members by state, plus the sector's own ETF row. Accepts a sector name (e.g. 'Energy', 'Information Technology') or its ETF symbol (e.g. XLE, XLK); unknown values return the sector directory. Free sample: top 3 members, headline fields, one market day delayed.
name: get_sector_read
